hypothesis: A fitted state-and-action-conditioned domain predictor can explain CartPoleWind dynamics substantially better than a candidate learned on unrelated synthetic role memory. A fair test must include fully trained strong stateless and stateful competitors; engineering fixture improvement is not scientific evidence.
null: The external-transfer claim does not survive conventional controls with matched factual data, or stronger control cannot be competently trained. An untrained model is never treated as a strong baseline.

source_policy.allowed_now: Only in-memory authored toy vectors with P80 key/effect shapes; no Causal-Gymnasium import, P84 FIT/CAL or OOD source generation, trainer dispatch, inference on externally collected data, runner/schedule changes
source_policy.facts: Only actually executed chronological (key16, effect16) memory writes; for training at t, state before event t and action_t are inputs, effect_t is label only AFTER prediction
source_policy.action_key: P80 16D unit state-action [bias,state-scaled4,onehot2,zero9], never action-only physical 16D
source_policy.target: P80 measured effect16 [tanh(normalized 4D state deltas),tanh(reward),terminated,truncated,zero9]; padded channels 7:16 must never count toward primary evaluation
source_policy.real_source_witness: P84 immutable source protocol and project-owned attestation required separately

linear7.architecture: nn.Linear(7,7) with bias; output padded with 9 exact zeros; uses current P80 state+action key and NO historical facts

mlp7.architecture: nn.Linear(7,32),SiLU,nn.Linear(32,7); output padded with 9 exact zeros; no historical facts

gru256.source: P69 TrainedGRU, as-is, no duplicated class; use P75 before_write_predictions; 16-output head includes nine padded outputs but loss never rewards zeros

ssm256.source: P69 DiagonalContinuousSSM as-is; P75 before_write_predictions; 16-output head includes nine padded outputs but loss never rewards zeros

zero.architecture: fixed zero predictor only as ablation, never strongest conventional

training.initializer: Seed-scoped CPU torch.random.fork_rng plus manual_seed(model_seed), same seed per arm but architecture differs; no global RNG pollution
training.fit_only: Only immutable independently witnessed FIT (128 episodes) after separately authorized first-use
training.cal_only: Only CAL (64) for checkpoint selection and fixed eta/sweep thresholds; no DEV or science OOD in optimizer or checkpoint selectors
training.objective: Per observed event t>=2 (one-indexed), prequential prediction from prefix<t factual effects plus current action, then loss on actually measured effect_t; optimize delta_loss(mean four normalized state-delta channels) + .2*reward_MSE + .1*terminated_MSE + .1*truncated_MSE. No padded zeros in loss. All arms see exactly same historical events and current action; recurrent use past true observed effects; stateless ignore history as architecture choice.
training.optimizer: AdamW learning_rate .001 for GRU/SSM, .005 for linear/MLP; weight_decay .01, grad_clip_norm 1
training.sample: Batch 16 independent episodes (variable lengths handled by world-wise or masked batching), up to 800 optimizer updates; select checkpoint every 50 updates by CAL four-delta MSE, with tie earliest step; first checkpoint only after 50 updates.
training.stop: Early stop allowed only after >=400 updates, six consecutive nonimproving CAL checkpoints, and CAL last-three delta-MSE spread<=.005; otherwise complete all 800. On nonfinite loss, resource or custody failure STOP, not retry uncertain source.
training.competence: All conventional arms must finish registration, restore best checkpoint, and achieve CAL delta MSE <=.75*zero-predictor CAL delta MSE for all 3 seeds; if this preset requirement is infeasible, record SCIENCE_CONTROL_FAIL and stop before any independent OOD.
training.resource: CPU development single thread, <=3 GiB peak and <=3600s per full conventional arm, no paid API; record wall time and full process generate/train/sweep/eval separately; cost parity not established merely by 256 persistent state floats
training.statistical: P84 frozen 5000 paired world bootstrap and 9 independent seed×OOD comparisons; do not select metrics on OOD

qualification: Separate prospective registration before any code or external source training
Model factory deterministic per seed; stateless model 0 persistent floats, GRU/SSM exactly 256 floats, all static weights separately counted
Reject privileged role, future effect, query target, held-out source; prequential predictions do not change when CURRENT event label changes
Cold restoration of GRU/SSM past state, original source, and readout information matched
Unit-normalized input and padded 9 channels enforced before any scoring
Primary loss uses only 4 physical delta channels, not padded 16D mean
Toy engineering optimization positive gradient and loss decrease without external simulator
Full exact candidate G4 Windows/Ubuntu regression and G5 Windows/Ubuntu and G7 Ubuntu CPU qualification
No OOD data, external first-use, model promotion, deployment, owner/runner/schedule changes
